book.name: LOMA
book.title: Loma wali Leta Pol wana Leleli

content: Pol ge Alonau wali Ba Lokaiyoni
Nuwau nula o ebo talila Poebe nuku yaliyaya-an, iya ekelesiya panuwa Senkuliya ana tolaba etegana.

Wala Babala alana eliyana nuku ahe ni ola toabulilek wala pagan, ge ebo bugul enuna ni kaubwa eliyana, inoke nuku labe, kaiwena iya wana labe i bwata gamagalau hi gewi eliyalil, ge i ola al nau eliyau.
No mulolu nuku pek yova Pilisila alona ge lagona Akuila elal, heliya alowau ha tuwalali toyawa Keliso Yeisu kaiwena.

Kaiweu yawaliliya hi talamwan yoho, yaomal nige hi lolovakun-an. He toto ya kaiwena ya ba mulolu nabi eliyalil. Yaa nige tage maiseu ya, yaa ekelesiya bolo hi minaa bolo nige Yudiya i oola wali labi elana hi ba mulolu al eliyalil.
Ge ya mulolu toekelesiya elal bolo hi tapwatapwalolowa wali limiya. Ya mulolu no heliyam waiwaisana Epainetas elana, iya Keliso i abulilek-an houwan labi Eisiya elana.
Ya mulolu Meli elana, iya i tuwalali nabi kaiwemiu.

Ya mulolu Andolonikas alona ge yova Yuniyasi elal, heliya no pan Yudiya ge valila alowau ha miminaa dela. Hi tuwalali i ola apostolo ge ali aatena i gan gamagalau gegewel elal. Nau mulaa abwe ya tabwa toabulilek, yaa heliya Keliso hi abulilek-an houwan.
Ya mulolu Ampiliyatas elana, iya Babala elana no heliyam waiwaisana.
Ya mulolu Ubanas elana, iya avala ta tuwalali toyawa Keliso kaiwena, ge ya mulolu Stakis elana, no heliyam waiwaisana.
Ya mulolu Apelis elana, iya bugul hi gewi kaiweliya i palahikan inoke ta atena bubun Keliso ana nunuwana i bwata elana. Ya mulolu Alistobulas alonau ge wana limi ana heniheni elal.
Ya mulolu Helodiyon elana, iya no pan Yudiya. Ya mulolu toabulilek elal bolo hi minaa Nasisas wana limiya.
Ya mulolu yowau Tilipina ge Tiliposa elal, heliya hi tuwalali nabi Babala kaiwena, ge ya mulolu yova Pesisi elana, iya ya nunuwana-an ge tuwalali i gewi i ginolil Babala kaiwena.
Ya mulolu Lupas elana, iya Babala wana totuwalali waiwaisana hot, ge ya mulolu hinana elana, wana pagan eliyau i ola nain.
Ya mulolu Asinkilitas, Pelegon, Hemisi, Patolobas ge Hemas elal, avaliyau ge talilau al bolo avaliyau hi mimina.
Ya mulolu Pilologas alona ge Yuliya, Neliyasi alona ge nuna, ge Olimpas elal, avaliyau ge Yehoba wana gamagalau al bolo avaliyau hi mimina.
Nimamiu nuku paelu alomiyau elal ge nuku pemumulolu-agimiu kaiwena komiu Yehoba wana gamagalau. Keliso wana ekelesiya gegewel labi ya elana hi mulolu eliyamiu.

Taliwau ge nuwau, ya ba pagasisi-agimiu nuku matahikagimiu gamagalau kaiweliya bolo panpankiti tutunahotina toto valila ku ahe hi awa nanakan, inoke toabulilek ali boda hi waliwali-an ge gamagalau enuna wali abulilek hi pwapweyata. Gamagalau ololal o nuku towaagil bahi nuku nonoek elal.

Heliya nige hi tutuwalali wala Babala Keliso kaiwena, yaa hi tuwalali ya te bugul bolo ni payaliyaya-agil kaiweliya. Wali liwaliwan i luviluvi ge i momoni, inoke eliyana gamagalau enuna bolo nige nuwaliya i sasapu hi kakawel.
Toabulilek labi gegewena wasamiu hi hago te Yehoba ku henapuan, inoke ya yaliyaya kaiwemiu. Yaa nuwau waisi nuku sibaan ge bahi nuku sisiba pagan nanakina kaiwena.
Sauga kekeisi abwe mibubun ana Yabowaine Seitani ni pulilolowan inoke Seitani nuku gasisi lake ge ni minaa aemiu gabulanaa. Wala Babala Yeisu wana mulolu ni minaa eliyamiu.
Timoti, iya no pan totuwalali, i mulolu eliyamiu, ge Lusiyasi, Yesoni ge Sosipata, heliya no pan Yudiya, heliya al hi mulolu eliyamiu.
Nau Tetiyasi Pol wana baaba ya leli lowan leta ya elana, inoke Babala alana elana ya mulolu eliyamiu.
Gaiyas, iya elana ya miminaa ge toekelesiya hi tatapwalolowa wana limiya, i mulolu eliyamiu. Elastas iya panuwa ya ana mani ana tomatahikan, alona ge talila Kuwotas hi mulolu eliyamiu.
Wala Babala Yeisu Keliso wana mulolu ni minaa ku gewigewi eliyamiu. Ibwe. I ola.

Yehoba ta awa wasawasa-an, iya bosowaina wami abulilek ni pagasisi, ni ola Wasa Waiwaisana toto ya papaatena-an, heiya Yeisu Keliso wasana. Wasa o sauga yayapona i misumi ga, yaa sauga ya i minaa mwananala.
Palopitau wali leleli i wasaan bubun, ge Yabowaine mihomihotina i ba yaka ama ha pamasal labi gegewena gamagaliliyau elal inoke nihi abulilek ge wana baaba nihi henapuan.
Yehoba, iya tosiba hot ge iya maisena ya Yabowaine tutunahotina, inoke Yeisu Keliso alana elana ta awa wasawasa-an sauga gegewena nige ni momowasi. Ibwe. I ola.

footnotes.text: Buki ana toleli papanet, bolo houhouwel, enuna puna 24 hi leli, enuna nige hi leleli.
